fields.description: Which copilot/module produced this draft, e.g. 'qms_copilot'. A shared, generic DocType (Phase 6A master plan §19E) — every AI-DEMO copilot that produces a draft/suggestion needing human approval reuses this SAME registry rather than a per-copilot table.
fields.label: Copilot Code

fields.description: The copilot's own use-case code, e.g. 'draft_capa', 'summarize_deviation'.
fields.label: Use Case

fields.description: The real business record this draft was generated FROM (e.g. the QMS Deviation being summarized).
fields.label: Source Reference

fields.description: The AI-generated draft/suggestion text. This is a SUGGESTION, never authoritative on its own — master plan principle #24: AI output in a regulated workflow defaults to suggestion/draft, never auto-final-approval.
fields.label: Content

fields.description: Optional structured JSON payload of suggested field values (e.g. a draft CAPA's capa_type/due_date/action_plan) used to pre-fill the resulting real record ONLY after human approval.
fields.label: Suggested Fields (JSON)

fields.description: Traceability to the AI Job Log entry (provider/model/tokens/cost) that produced this draft's content.
fields.label: Generated By (AI Job Log)

fields.description: The real human user who approved or rejected this draft. Required before status can leave 'Draft' — enforced in code, not just convention (never the AI itself).
fields.label: Reviewed By

fields.description: Set only when approval converted this draft into a NEW real business record (e.g. a draft_capa's approval creates a real QMS CAPA). Left empty for use cases where approval simply endorses the draft text itself (e.g. a reviewed summary) without minting a new record.
fields.label: Resulting DocType
